purpose: Teach: 花屋/満腹/ひく/きのこ/けんか/人参/レタス/貰える

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、花屋さん、絶対、よく、本気で、行ったよな、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, you'd go to the shrine festival and the flower shop with me all the time. You remember, don't you?
lines.style: Slow, gentle opening. Nostalgic warmth in the voice. Trails into the question like he's testing if the memory is still there. Soft, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんの料理、本気で、絶対、家族、絶対、満腹に、絶対、なったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. Your grandmother's cooking — the whole family would be so full and happy. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright recall, almost surprised by her own warmth. Speaking to the memory as much as to him. Soft landing on the question, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、風邪を、絶対、ひくこと、ないように、絶対、お互いに、本気で、気をつけような、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、約束、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: These days, let's be careful with each other about catching colds, all right? Let's make that a promise, gran.
lines.style: Quieter shift in tone — protective without being alarming. Gentle insistence. The words are light but the care underneath is steady and real.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、きのこ狩り、絶対、二人で、絶対、よく、本気で、行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、思い出、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Back then, the two of us would go mushroom hunting so often. Do you remember, dear? I think about those times so much.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy quality. Speaking more to the past than to him. Gentle rhythm, like turning pages in an old album. Trails with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、私たち、絶対、けんか、絶対、よく、本気で、したよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?今、思うと、本気で、絶対、笑える、本気、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, you and I used to fight quite a lot, didn't we? But thinking about it now, it makes me laugh.
lines.style: Wry amusement in the opening. The words are light but there's real affection underneath. A small laugh on 'laugh' — knowing, not bitter.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、人参、絶対、苦手だった子供たち、絶対、いたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When the kids were young, there were some who really didn't like carrots. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, almost conspiratorial warmth. The rhythm is unhurried. She's inviting him to share in the small, fond observation of something that mattered then.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、レタス、絶対、まだ、絶対、珍しかった時代、覚えてる?ばあさん
lines.en: When we were young, lettuce was still such a rare thing. Those were different times, weren't they, dear?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle wonder. No rush in the pacing. Like he's seeing that time again and finding it precious because it's gone. Quiet marvel.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 息子から、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、貰える時、絶対、嬉しいわよね、あなた、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: When our son brings back gifts for us, it makes me so happy. You know how that feels, don't you, dear? That gratitude.
lines.style: Warm, genuine smile in the voice. Slower pace on the remembering part. She's speaking to something both of them understand deeply — the joy of being thought of.
